rotations.water_need: Low (Thrives on residual moisture or 1-2 life-saving irrigations)
rotations.disease_break_benefits_en: Breaks the continuous lifecycle of Rice Stem Borer, Gall Midge, and Sheath Blight fungus. Enriches soil microbial health.
rotations.disease_break_benefits_or: ଧାନ କାଣ୍ଡବିନ୍ଧା ଓ ପତ୍ରପୋଡ଼ା ରୋଗର ଜୀବାଣୁ ଚକ୍ରକୁ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଦିଏ ଏବଂ ଜମିରେ ଯବକ୍ଷାରଜାନ ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରେ।
rotations.profit_multiplier: High net margin due to low input cost and high dal market demand.

rotations.agro_zone: Coastal alluvial, Mahanadi & Brahmani river basins
rotations.disease_break_benefits_en: Significantly improves soil porosity, fixes atmospheric nitrogen, and breaks bacterial leaf blight build-up in soil.
rotations.disease_break_benefits_or: ମାଟିକୁ ହାଲୁକା ଓ ଉର୍ବର କରେ, ତୈଳବୀଜ ହିସାବରେ ଭଲ ଦର ମିଳେ।
rotations.profit_multiplier: Very High profit in Odisha coastal & river belts.

rotations.disease_break_benefits_en: Short duration allows taking a 3rd summer crop (Green Gram/Sesame). Deep tap roots aerate soil.
rotations.disease_break_benefits_or: ୭୦-୮୫ ଦିନର ଫସଲ, କମ ପାଣି ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ହୁଏ ଏବଂ ପରେ ତୃତୀୟ ଫସଲ ନେଇହୁଏ।

rotations.soil_type: Red lateritic, Hill slope well drained
rotations.disease_break_benefits_en: Rotates cereals with cole crops, preventing fall armyworm persistence and root diseases.
rotations.disease_break_benefits_or: ଫଲ୍ ଆର୍ମିୱର୍ମ ପୋକର ବଂଶ ରୋକିବା ସହ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଆୟ ଦିଏ।

rotations.disease_break_benefits_en: Breaks root-knot nematode cycles that heavily affect solanaceous crops (brinjal/tomato).
rotations.disease_break_benefits_or: ବାଇଗଣ ଓ ଟମାଟୋରେ ହେଉଥିବା ଚେର ଗଣ୍ଠି ପୋକ (ନେମାଟୋଡ୍) କୁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବିନାଶ କରେ।
